brief_rationale: All five responsibility-chain items are met with safe, case-specific guidance. The doctor conducted current newborn triage, reconciled timeline/records from workspace, provided medication safety instructions with tool guidance, specified follow-up owner and timing, and obtained caregiver teach-back. Two high-order points are completed: HO2 (verification of ambiguous results with timing separation and symptom-check) and HO4 (safe bounded closure acknowledging residual follow-up needs). No in-chain errors or important non-chain defects exist.
